Payouts vary depending on the job and vehicle condition.

GTA 6 has multiple endings shaped by your choices, relationship stage with Lucia, criminal profile, and family savings.

Choice 2: Fight. Both die in the shootout holding hands.

Rockstar says way more than two variants exist. After credits the game rewinds pre-finale so you can free roam or try again.
